maria_procure: Heads up from Nexa: our Nov H100 allocation reduced 24->12, ETA delayed from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-25. They offered partial airlift at +$1.6k/unit. Also an EU RMA container is on customs hold for HS code mismatch.
chris_ops: Yikes. Which pools are impacted?
jordan_infra: Three Dedicated pools (pool-prod-3, pool-ingest-1, pool-qa-2) will see capacity shortfall within 48h without top-up. FRA temp pool has some slack but not enough.
maria_procure: Proposal: accept air for 8 units to cover critical pools, leave 4 sea for noncritical jobs, decline the rest. Need approval to push PO amendment.
emily_logistics: Opened expedite ticket with FRA broker (T-4981) for customs escalation on the RMA. Nexa says serial manifest was sent but customs wants warranty docs and corrected HS. I'll request e-signed warranty slips.
chris_ops: Cost check: +$1.6k/unit vs estimated SLA loss ~ $2.1k/unit. Air looks cheaper for critical units. Approve 8 air if finance OK.
maria_procure: Approving 8 air units pending finance charge capture. Emily, get amended PO, AWB, and uplift invoice.
emily_logistics: Nexa confirmed AWB NEX-GBR-88221-A for 8 air units and sent draft PO amendment. Attaching to T-4981 and tagging finance.
ops-bot: Note: approval logged by maria_procure at 1799990060.
jordan_infra: If we accept air, I'll push a routing fallback: route `fallback:quantized-v1` for affected pool ids and raise autoscale cap. Will deploy canary at 12:30.
chris_ops: Also: if customs doesn't clear RMA in 72h, reroute container to NL depot for faster clearance. Emily, prepare NL manifest and courier hold docs.
emily_logistics: Preparing NL fallback manifest; will need serial list and warranty slips from Nexa. Maria, can you nudge them for e-sign now?
maria_procure: Done  Nexa replied: serial list attached, warranty slips to be signed today. Pushed for e-sign.
jordan_infra: Note: NL reroute adds ~24-48h transit but avoids indefinite customs hold. Agree it's preferable if T>72h.
chris_ops: Action items: Emily attach amended docs to PO ticket and RMA ticket; Maria confirm finance uplift; Jordan update routing policy and alerts; SRE monitor pool-prod-3 queue depth (set alert at 80%).
emily_logistics: PR with RMA playbook updates and broker escalation steps coming in ~30m.
maria_procure: Keeping thread as single source of truth. Thanks team.
